Unit regressions and a real native search cancellation smoke pass. Download/install cancellation still requires validation on a controlled machine with available updates.

Application rejects missing, duplicate, or wrong-revision results. Regression tests pass; actual installation/revision-change scenarios remain to be validated on a controlled machine.
